caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a shield-shaped iron trivet, rendered in shades of dark brown and black. It consists of an outer triangular frame with a rounded top and an inwardly pointed bottom. Inside the frame, there are decorative cut-out patterns, including two stacked heart shapes, each with a diamond-shaped form at their intersection, and below these are two curved, intersecting lines forming a lattice-like pattern. The trivet appears three-dimensional due to shading that highlights its contours, edges, and the thickness of the metal. There are no other objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Trivet
